through_line.name: the cold slice
through_line.prop_prompt: a single cold slice of pepperoni pizza with a stiff curled edge and congealed cheese, beside a tall bottle of bright blue sports drink with the cap off
progression: a stiff flat shape descending slowly
the slice coming down sideways, refusing to bend
the slice lands cold and starts talking
a wave of blue liquid arrives on top of it
the blue and the slice have not mixed at all
a delivery notification lights the room

blocks.through_line_state: a stiff flat shape descending slowly
blocks.sfx: a cardboard box flap, a slow slide, a quiet swallow
shots: MEDIUM, eye level: Pipes whispering downward, wincing at his own volume
CLOSE, low angle: Gut lying flat, one eye barely open
MEDIUM, high angle: a stiff flat shape descending slowly above
CLOSE on the eyes: Gut closing his eye again

turns.speaker: pipes
turns.line: Gut? You alive down there?

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: Do not speak loudly right now.

turns.speaker: pipes
turns.line: Sorry. There's cold pizza coming down.

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: Pizza. At one in the afternoon.

blocks.through_line_state: the slice coming down sideways, refusing to bend
blocks.sfx: a stiff scrape, a hollow knock, a groan
shots: CLOSE, low angle: Gut speaking without opening his eyes
MEDIUM, eye level: the stiff slice jamming crossways against Pipes
MEDIUM, high angle: a blue bottle waiting above it
CLOSE on Pipes' eyes darting between the two

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: Where was this pizza last night?

turns.speaker: pipes
turns.line: In a box. On the counter.

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: It should have come down then.

turns.speaker: pipes
turns.line: There's a blue drink too. Full one.

blocks.through_line_state: the slice lands cold and starts talking
blocks.sfx: a flat cold slap, a hollow echo, a chipper pop
shots: MEDIUM, high angle: the slice landing completely flat and rigid
CLOSE, low angle: two cheerful eyes opening on the cold cheese
MEDIUM, eye level: Gut not moving at all
CLOSE on the eyes: the slice bright, Gut vacant

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: You're cold. Why are you cold?

turns.speaker: pizza
turns.line: Counter all night! Perfectly fine!

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: That's not how counters work.

turns.speaker: pizza
turns.line: The blue drink says it's fine!

blocks.through_line_state: a wave of blue liquid arrives on top of it
blocks.sfx: a phone buzz, a dull throb, a wince
shots: MEDIUM, eye level: HQ sitting on the floor of the red chamber, phone face down
CLOSE, low angle: HQ pressing one small arm against its own side
MEDIUM, high angle: the wall veins throbbing slowly
CLOSE on HQ's eyes refusing to open

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: HQ. What happened last night?

turns.speaker: hq
turns.line: I'm not answering that question.

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: You were there. You approved everything.

turns.speaker: hq
turns.line: I approved nothing. I was offline.

blocks.through_line_state: the blue and the slice have not mixed at all
blocks.sfx: a heavy shuffle, a long sigh, a slow drip
shots: CLOSE, low angle: Liv already in frame, already working, already furious
MEDIUM, eye level: Gut approaching carefully
MEDIUM, high angle: Liv turning her back and continuing
CLOSE on the eyes: Liv not looking up once

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: Liv. I'm sorry about last night.

turns.speaker: liv
turns.line: Oh, so now we're apologizing.

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: Can you do anything at all?

turns.speaker: liv
turns.line: I've been working since eleven. Alone.

blocks.through_line_state: a delivery notification lights the room
blocks.sfx: a phone notification chime, one low rumble, silence
shots: MEDIUM, eye level: the monitor blinking on above the dark tunnel
CLOSE, low angle: an order confirmation glowing on the pale screen
MEDIUM, high angle: Gut sagging completely
CLOSE on the eyes: Rusty opening his, unhurried

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: She's ordering more food. On the app.

turns.speaker: rusty
turns.line: Of course she is.

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: Rusty, I can't do this twice.

turns.speaker: rusty
turns.line: Nobody asked you. Lie down.
